skills.detail: Creates a multiple hit attack near long-range enemies that continues to move towards them and deal percentage damage. The attack will disappear after it hits an enemy or an obstacle, or after a certain period of time has passed. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
skills.name: I Won't Let You Do as You Please

skills.detail: A long-range charge attack with a Knockback effect. Creates an area that increases the SPD of you and your allies. The area is removed after a certain period of time or when the user is KO'd. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
